latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Customer Service Caller:

- Polly calls customer service for you—navigates menus, waits on hold, and explains your issue.
- Outbound calls: handles reservations, complaints, refunds, cancellations, and more.
- Incoming calls: answers on your behalf, summarizes messages, and filters spam.
- Simple registration & activation flow with guided setup messages.
- Requires curl, jq, and bc; includes helper scripts for all core functions.
- Supports multi-language calls and customizable AI call answering.
